text:
Sara (AE): Quick heads-up — partner (CloudForge) wants a co-sell POC with one of their enterprise customers. They want a joint arch diagram, pricing for a reserved POC, security questionnaire answers, and SAML/SCIM support. Can we stand this up? 

Raj (Partner SE): Customer requirements: VPC/private deployment, SAML SSO + SCIM, EU data residency (eu-west-1), HSM for keys (preferred). POC length ~6 weeks. They also want a simple revenue-share outline.

Mike (Solutions): We can do a Redwood Private deployment in a customer VPC. SAML + SCIM supported. HSM is trickier; we support KMS now. Anita, can you confirm SAML cert exchange flow and whether SCIM endpoints are ready?

Anita (Eng): SAML+SCIM: yes. We'll need the customer's IdP metadata URL and certs. For VPC deployment we'll need these config fields:
```
vpc_cidr: "10.0.0.0/16"
subnets: ["10.0.1.0/24", "10.0.2.0/24"]
saml_metadata_url: "https://idp.company.com/metadata.xml"
scim_endpoint: "https://scim.partner.com/v2/"
kms_provider: "aws-kms"
```
We can provide a preflight checklist and an install runbook.

Raj (Partner SE): Great. Pricing: partner asking for dedicated reserved for POC — baseline throughput 4k tokens/sec (burst to 8k). Ballpark monthly commit to propose to customer?

Mike (Solutions): Ballpark for Dedicated reserved (4 GPUs equiv): $45k/mo committed. If they want a 6-week POC we can pro-rate or offer a short-term discounted commit. I'll draft 2 options: pro-rate and a special POC credit. See pricing sheet: https://redwood.internal/pricing/dedicated

Sara (AE): Also need to know co-sell revenue split + any partner credit. @Tom (Legal) — any quick guidance?

Tom (Legal): For co-sell we use the standard reseller addendum. Revenue share is negotiated; for POCs we usually offer credits not revenue splits. I'll attach the MSA addendum and a co-sell template. Please send me the partner/customer names and expected ARR if/when we close.

DeployBot: :robot_face: Task created: #poc-cloudforge-setup assigned to Anita, Mike, Raj — due 2026-04-05.

Anita (Eng): Enterprise blocker: customer insists on HSM (FIPS 140-2) for key material. Current Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS CloudHSM optional) — but on-prem HSM passthrough would require engineering scoping. If HSM is mandatory we need to scope additional work and timeline.

Mike (Solutions): Proposal: recommend BYO KMS with AWS CloudHSM (customer-managed) for now; escalate HSM passthrough as a roadmap item. We'll flag as risk on the SOW.

Sara (AE): Action items:
- Anita: produce SAML/SCIM checklist + sample metadata and runbook (due 2026-03-30)
- Mike: draft pricing options (committed + pro-rate + POC credit) and include risk note about HSM (due 2026-03-29)
- Tom: send MSA addendum and co-sell template (due 2026-03-28)
- Raj: confirm customer infra windows and send invite for kickoff Tue 2026-04-02 10am PST

Raj (Partner SE): Confirmed — will send invite and include partner SE + customer infra lead. :thumbsup: 

Sara (AE): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll drop the partner intro email once Mike has the pricing draft.
